verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a Segment-style customer data pipeline, so visual audience building is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no visual audience builder, no no-SQL segmentation, and no audience size estimate before activation. The closest feature is Profile Builder, which builds customer profiles from `traits` and uses JavaScript for custom logic; that is adjacent profile generation, not marketer-facing audience building.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating
